units.Description: HFA is a robust-scaled, dimensionless envelope estimate (median removed, divided by the 10th-90th percentile range per sub-band, then averaged), so it has no physical unit.

low_cutoff.Description: Lower edge of the HFA band (70-150 Hz) the envelope was extracted from; the time series itself is sampled at 100 Hz.

high_cutoff.Description: Upper edge of the HFA band.

status.Description: bad = electrode flagged by the authors as noisy or epileptic (dataInfo.idxNoisyElecs / idxEpilepticElecs); the authors excluded these from their analyses. The HFA values are kept as released.

author_reference_electrode.Description: true for the electrode index stored in dataInfo.idxRefElec (as stored; empty in some patients).

n_outlier_samples.Description: Number of samples marked true for this channel in the authors' artifacts matrix.
